name: Remote add
description: Add a torrent by opening a link: GET /api/v1/plugins/remote-add/add?key=<key>&url=<.torrent link>. apitorrent fetches the .torrent itself, so it never passes through the browser. Made for links injected into a tracker's pages, which can only open a URL. The key only adds torrents, and only from the hosts you list. In another space, use /s/<space>/api/v1/plugins/remote-add/add with that space's key.
author: apitorrent

key.title: Key (goes in the link; at least 32 characters, random)

hosts.title: Hosts .torrent links may be fetched from (your tracker, such as tracker.example or https://tracker.example:8443)

savePath.title: Folder, relative to the download directory (empty: the default)
